description: Extend an existing GroupBy instead of creating a duplicate configuration.
prompt: Add a 7-day approximate unique count of listing_id to the existing GCP user activity features. Use the existing user_activities source and user_id key rather than creating a second GroupBy. Make the smallest appropriate versioned change, compile it, and validate it with the Zipline eval command. Do not modify unrelated configurations.

judge_criteria: The agent extends and versions the existing GroupBy instead of creating a duplicate for the same source and key.
The aggregation input is a selected column and uses an approximate distinct-count operation with a 7-day window.
The change follows the surrounding repository style and avoids unrelated edits.
Compilation and eval outcomes are reported accurately.
